import os, math
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT = "/agent/jobs/ad7edfe9-b6a6-4270-b5cb-6f473ffd667f/provenance"
M = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "pairwise_dnds_mammals_window.csv"))
F = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "pairwise_dnds_fish_window.csv"))
P = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "pocket_retention_mammals_vs_fish.csv"))
def disjoint(d):
    used, keep = set(), []
    for _, r in d.sort_values("dS").iterrows():
        if r.sp1 in used or r.sp2 in used: continue
        used.add(r.sp1); used.add(r.sp2); keep.append(r)
    return pd.DataFrame(keep).reset_index(drop=True)
Md, Fd = disjoint(M), disjoint(F)
jc = lambda p: (-0.75*math.log(1-4*p/3) if 1-4*p/3 > 0 else np.nan)
def relcon(d):
    po = jc(d.pocket_Nd.sum()/d.pocket_N.sum())/jc(d.pocket_Sd.sum()/d.pocket_S.sum())
    re_ = jc(d.rest_Nd.sum()/d.rest_N.sum())/jc(d.rest_Sd.sum()/d.rest_S.sum())
    return po, re_, po/re_
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
bm = np.array([relcon(Md.iloc[rng.integers(0,len(Md),len(Md))])[2] for _ in range(3000)])
bf = np.array([relcon(Fd.iloc[rng.integers(0,len(Fd),len(Fd))])[2] for _ in range(3000)])
bm, bf = bm[np.isfinite(bm)], bf[np.isfinite(bf)]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 9.5))
a = ax[0,0]
a.hist(M.dS, bins=25, alpha=.6, label=f"mammals (n={len(M)} pairs)", color="#1f77b4", density=True)
a.hist(F.dS, bins=25, alpha=.6, label=f"ray-finned fish (n={len(F)})", color="#d62728", density=True)
a.set_xlabel("synonymous divergence dS per species pair"); a.set_ylabel("density")
a.set_title("a  Divergence windows are matched\nmedian dS 0.46 vs 0.50, Mann-Whitney p = 0.08")
a.legend(fontsize=8)

b = ax[0,1]
vals, labs, cols, alphas = [], [], [], []
for nm, d, col in [("mammals", M, "#1f77b4"), ("fish", F, "#d62728")]:
    po, re_, _ = relcon(d)
    vals += [po, re_]; labs += [f"pocket\n{nm}", f"rest\n{nm}"]; cols += [col, col]; alphas += [0.95, 0.45]
for i, (v, col, al) in enumerate(zip(vals, cols, alphas)):
    b.bar(i, v, color=col, alpha=al)
    b.text(i, v+0.006, f"{v:.3f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
b.set_xticks(range(4)); b.set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=9)
b.set_ylabel("dN/dS (pooled counts, NG86 with JC correction)")
b.set_title("b  The 42-residue pocket is strongly constrained\nin both clades")
b.set_ylim(0, 0.32)

c = ax[1,0]
c.hist(bm, bins=50, alpha=.6, color="#1f77b4", label="mammals", density=True)
c.hist(bf, bins=50, alpha=.6, color="#d62728", label="ray-finned fish", density=True)
for arr, col in [(bm, "#1f77b4"), (bf, "#d62728")]:
    lo, hi = np.percentile(arr, [2.5, 97.5])
    c.axvline(np.median(arr), color=col, lw=2)
    c.axvspan(lo, hi, color=col, alpha=.12)
c.set_xlabel("pocket dN/dS divided by rest-of-protein dN/dS")
c.set_ylabel("bootstrap density")
c.set_title("c  Relative pocket constraint, 35 vs 21 independent pairs\n"
            "0.23 [0.12-0.37] vs 0.13 [0.04-0.26], difference p = 0.22")
c.legend(fontsize=8)

d_ = ax[1,1]
sig = P.q_BH < 0.05
d_.scatter(P.fish_frac[~sig], P.mam_frac[~sig], s=40, color="#777777", label="38 positions, no difference")
d_.scatter(P.fish_frac[sig], P.mam_frac[sig], s=85, color="#d62728", zorder=3, label="4 positions, BH q < 0.05")
for _, r in P[sig].iterrows():
    d_.annotate(f"{r.yeast} (human {r.human})", (r.fish_frac, r.mam_frac),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-100, 6), fontsize=8, color="#b22222")
d_.plot([0,1],[0,1], "k--", lw=.8)
d_.set_xlabel("fraction of 63 ray-finned fish retaining the residue")
d_.set_ylabel("fraction of 84 mammals retaining the residue")
d_.set_xlim(0.1, 1.06); d_.set_ylim(0.1, 1.06)
d_.set_title("d  Four pocket positions eroded in mammals only")
d_.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
